name: Alpenblick
beschreibung: Gasthof Alpenblick is located in the Tyrolean municipality of Schattwald in the district of Reutte. Situated in a quiet position on the edge of the village, it offers panoramic vistas of the Allgäu and Lechtal Alps. The rooms are equipped with private bath, toilet, satellite TV, and some include a balcony. The restaurant serves regional culinary classics alongside international dishes. Amenities include a guest garden and a wellness area with a sauna and steam bath. Hiking and skiing tours can be started directly from the guesthouse. The family-run property welcomes guests all year round.
